content.text: {"id": "mm7019e1", "data_focus": {"v": "yes", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Among 3,679 (38%) B.1.526 variant viruses identified, 2,050 (56%) carried the E484K mutation."}, {"loc": "text", "q": "were more likely to be hospitalized (5.8%) than were persons with non-VOI/VOC infections (4.1%) (p = 0.04)"}]}, "outcome_types": [{"v": "binary/categorical", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Among persons with B.1.526 infections, 2,618 (71%) were symptomatic, 104 (4.3%) were hospitalized, and 11 (0.5%) died"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "The proportion of B.1.526 viruses identified increased from 3% in mid-January to 34% by February 22"}]}], "analytic_depth": [{"v": "summary", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "By April 5, the B.1.526 variant accounted for 40% of all viruses sequenced"}]}, {"v": "comparison", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "were more likely to be hospitalized (5.8%) than were persons with non-VOI/VOC infections (4.1%) (p = 0.04)"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "Persons infected with B.1.526 were compared with persons infected with variants that were not classified as VOIs or VOCs"}]}], "study_design": [{"v": "surveillance/descriptive", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "The NYC Department of Health and Mental Hygiene (DOHMH) analyzed laboratory and epidemiologic data to characterize cases of B.1.526 infection"}]}, {"v": "before/after or trend", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "The proportion of B.1.526 viruses identified increased from 3% in mid-January to 34% by February 22"}]}], "methods_quotes": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Comparisons across categorical characteristics were made using the chi-square or Fisher’s exact test; continuous variables were compared using the Kruskal-Wallis test"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "Records of persons with sequenced viruses were matched to the DOHMH COVID-19 surveillance Citywide Immunization and Vital Registry databases."}, {"loc": "text", "q": "A case of possible reinfection was defined as an infection in a person with a sequenced specimen collected ≥90 days after"}, {"loc": "note", "q": "Persons with specimens collected March 23–April 5 were excluded from severity and transmission metrics"}], "confidence": "medium", "uncertain_fields": ["outcome_types"]}
